The Chinese characters for Blake

As a transliteration, Blake is usually written 布莱克 (Bù lái kè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

布
Bù
cloth, spread
莱
lái
a herb (transliteration)
克
kè
overcome, gram

Origin and meaning

From English, Blake carries the meaning “dark-haired or pale (of uncertain origin)”.
